nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You could be lying, but what's the alternative? Staying here and being one of your doormats?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No one steps on me. `I` do the stepping.
nodes.text_bbcode: No one steps on me. [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] do the stepping.

nodes.text: Before Jessica can reply, Paige runs for the door, flinging it open!
She finds herself in a hallway, looking at another door, just as Jessica described!
She sprints to it and tries to pull it open...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Locked! I guess Jessica wasn't lying!
Paige turns back around, but the first door is now blocked by Brock!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Come. You. Trouble.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know.
Brock marches Paige out through the cafeteria, past Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Told you so! Maybe, oh, I don't know, `listen` to me next time?
nodes.text_bbcode: Told you so! Maybe, oh, I don't know, [color=#3b78e2][i]listen[/i][/color] to me next time?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How about never?
Paige notices several of the other girls smile and whisper as she passes them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Enjoy your punishment!
Paige sits back down...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Good.` Very good. You totally would have been caught!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Good.[/i][/color] Very good. You totally would have been caught!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How am I supposed to escape then?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Haven't you been listening? If everything `I've` done has been designed to get revenge on $ZOE, don't you think I would have escaped by now?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Haven't you been listening? If everything [color=#3b78e2][i]I've[/i][/color] done has been designed to get revenge on $ZOE, don't you think I would have escaped by now?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There `is` no escape. Brock is `always` there. Always watching.
nodes.text_bbcode: There [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] no escape. Brock is [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] there. Always watching.

nodes.text: As if on cue, Brock returns to his post at the door, as menacing as ever.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You just have to serve out your term until you graduate from this place.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Which is why I say...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Make the most of it! Be a lion with me, Paige! We could have `so` much fun together!
nodes.text_bbcode: Make the most of it! Be a lion with me, Paige! We could have [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much fun together!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If I become like you, it's like I'm admitting that I'll never get out...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Duh! That's exactly what I'm saying! Just come to my party next week, okay?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, since I'm, like, replacing someone on the guest list with you, it's only fair that you do me a little favor, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What kind of favor?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Relax... It's nothing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'll make sure Whitford knows!
Before Paige can summon the will to protest, Jessica sashays off.
That night...
Principal Whitford is standing in the doorway of the restroom in front of Paige.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'm surprised you volunteered to take over Jessica's bathroom cleaning duties!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe Jessica suckered me into this!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh well, it's not so bad. It's not like a bunch of rich, spoiled girls are going to cause that big of a mess.
Whitford steps aside, and Paige gasps!
Lipstick graffiti plasters the walls, damp hair coats the sink like a giant spider web, and an unbelievable stench emanates from the stalls.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You're done when I can see my reflection in every surface!
Whitford closes the door behind her.
As Paige dumps her mop into a trough of dark-colored soap water, she knows...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now that we've settled that nasty chair situation, we can talk about who we both are and the friendship we'll be forming together!
Paige's eyes flitter towards a door in the back of the cafeteria. Brock stands next to it, his arms crossed over his chest.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If Brock wasn't there, I bet I could escape through that door! Why guard it unless there's something to guard, right?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It may seem totes boring, but it's important that you pay attention to me, okay?
Paige nods.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I used to go to your stupid school, back when it was actually cool and called Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The mascot wasn't super lame, either. We were the Lizards.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway, I was pretty much the biggest deal ever `ever.` I was Head Cheerleader, `and` I was about to become First Lady.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, I was pretty much the biggest deal ever [color=#3b78e2][i]ever.[/i][/color] I was Head Cheerleader, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] I was about to become First Lady.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You were going to marry, like, the president?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?! No! I was going to be the girlfriend of the `school` president!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! No! I was going to be the girlfriend of the [color=#3b78e2][i]school[/i][/color] president!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: In case you don't know, that means high-limit credit cards, limo rides, meeting celebrities... Oh, and...
As Jessica continues to list perks, Brock suddenly hurries off down the hall, leaving the door unprotected!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I bet he's going to the bathroom! This is my chance!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey! Are you paying attention to me?!
Jessica leans in her chair, blocking Paige's view of the door.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course I am!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh yeah, then what was the name of your stupid school called back when I went there?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Really? You think back when I went to your school it was called the same thing it's called `now?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? You think back when I went to your school it was called the same thing it's called [color=#3b78e2][i]now?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not my best answer, but whatever.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Normally, I'm not all that big on education, but you should, like, totes study more. Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway, where was I? Oh yeah...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's not it! I knew you weren't paying attention!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I was paying attention, I just got bored!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine! I'll sum it up for you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The school used to be awesome. Now it sucks.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I was going to own everyone and everything!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay, I'm totes sorry! I thought you weren't listening.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well I `was.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well I [color=#3b78e2][i]was.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyways, where was I? Oh yeah...
Paige is about to bolt for the door when...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I would have been First Lady if it wasn't for that goody-goody princess, `$ZOE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I would have been First Lady if it wasn't for that goody-goody princess, [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The mention of $ZOE's name is enough to make Paige settle back into her chair...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I `so` knew that would get your attention!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] knew that would get your attention!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: After all, she's, like, the one that's been after your guy, isn't she?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How do you know about that?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I get visitors.
Jessica leans forward in her chair.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've been in this dump for a long time, and the one thing that's kept me going is the thought of getting even with that goody-goody princess!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why are you telling me this?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because you and I are a lot alike.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pfft. Doubtful.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not only do we both hate $ZOE, but we're both lions. We dominate and conquer.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You used to rule this place back in the day, so I'm letting you know two things...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: One, this school is mine now! And two, that doesn't mean I can't share a small piece of my territory.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's the saying? Keep your friends close, and your best friends closer?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not interested.
Paige's eyes land on the door again. She stands up, poised to make a break for it, when Jessica grabs her by the wrist!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not interested?! So the rumors are true! That Owen guy has made you weak and soft-hearted.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The Paige `I` heard about never would have refused a chance for power.
nodes.text_bbcode: The Paige [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] heard about never would have refused a chance for power.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, well, like I said I'm `not` like you. So let go of me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, like I said I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] like you. So let go of me!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I tried to escape through that door during my first breakfast, too, you know?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How did you know I was--?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I told you, we're a lot alike.
Jessica lets go of Paige's wrist.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Through that door is another locked door. Even if you have the key to it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: By the time you think you've finally made it, Brock will grab you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But, hey, I could be lying!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ice queen?! You'd better think twice about who you insult!
Jessica nods to Amber.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Like Amber here, who called me bossy and lost her blanket privileges!
Paige can see Amber shivering.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who am I dealing with?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Go sit somewhere else, Amber!
Amber scurries off, and Jessica gestures to the now empty seat. Paige sits.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, I'm going to like you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Amber, go sit anywhere else!
The girl sitting next to Jessica sadly leaves.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Looks like a seat just opened up for you, Paige.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I noticed.
Paige sits down in Amber's old seat.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatever I say?! Where's your backbone?! Where's the fiery girl I've heard, like, `so` much about?
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever I say?! Where's your backbone?! Where's the fiery girl I've heard, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much about?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know what you're talking about!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, there's a `hint` of her. Amber, scram!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there's a [color=#3b78e2][i]hint[/i][/color] of her. Amber, scram!

nodes.text: The girl sitting next to Paige sadly leaves.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sit.
Paige does what Jessica says.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You've become kinda pathetic, huh? That's what happens when you start acting `nice.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You've become kinda pathetic, huh? That's what happens when you start acting [color=#3b78e2][i]nice.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway...
She flops down on the bed and tries to block out the cold, tries to remember a happy memory with Owen...
But all she can remember is the conversation they had on their picnic...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You live in a four-story mansion and eat on plates of gold. You can't tell me you're not a prissy snob.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is that really what you think of me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? Do you have a problem with it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What if I do?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I mean... Wait, really?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Usually, you love the fact that you're a mean rich girl who thinks she's better than anyone else.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just because that's what I `am` doesn't mean I `like` being called that...
nodes.text_bbcode: Just because that's what I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] doesn't mean I [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] being called that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sure I follow...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You wouldn't. You just don't get it...
She's brought out of her memory by the sounds of crying coming from some of the other girls' rooms.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now that I think about it... It's weird how the clouds came in so quickly after that!
Paige panics!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not my coat!
Brock reaches her and holds out one of his large, bear-sized hands.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Jacket.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grr! Do `not` get any of your oaf-sweat on it, got it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Grr! Do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] get any of your oaf-sweat on it, got it?!

nodes.text: She reluctantly hands it to him.
For a second, she catches an odd look on Brock's face... But she can't place it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What was that? It almost looked like... `Disappointment.`
nodes.text_bbcode: What was that? It almost looked like... [color=#3b78e2][i]Disappointment.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: After Paige finishes her last push up, she slowly rises to her feet.
Paige falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Start over!
Paige's arms buckle! She falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ow!`

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You owe me `ten!` In a `row!` Start over!
Paige's arms wobble, and she falls flat on her face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Erg!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Can you count?! You will give me `ten!` No less! Start over!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine. I'll do the stupid push-ups!
Paige gets down into a push-up position.
Paige falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Start over!
Paige's arms buckle! She falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ow!`

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You owe me `ten!` In a `row!` Start over!
Paige's arms wobble, and she falls flat on her face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Erg!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Can you count?! You will give me `ten!` No less! Start over!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! I'm not some slave! And I don't belong here!
For one second, Brock smiles. Then Whitford nods at him, and the smile disappears!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Girl. Want. Worse?
Paige sighs.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! Fine! I'll do the stupid five push ups!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Because you refused, there are now ten to do!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Awesome.
Paige gets down into push-up position. With her knees still touching the ground, she starts her first push-up.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: No. `Real` push-up.
nodes.text_bbcode: No. [color=#e23b3b][i]Real[/i][/color] push-up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, come on! I've lived a sedentary lifestyle!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh! Fine!
She lifts her knees up off the ground, her arms wobbling.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever.
Outside, Tad holds onto Paige even tighter than before... She knows there will be no escaping.
He forces her into the backseat of their towncar, and Margot enters from the other side, sandwiching her in.
Margot addresses the driver.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: To Monarch Prep. The Butterfly Detention Center Wing. The faster the better.
As they leave behind the estate and speed down the road toward Monarch Prep, they pass a lone figure, walking with a bounce in his step!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's Owen on his way to the bus stop!
They whip past him without him ever knowing Paige is in the car, and all Paige can think is...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Will I ever see him again?
Later that night...
Owen steps through the front door of his grandma's house, whistling! Grandma Betty shuffles into the kitchen to meet him.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Well, well, Owie! Look what's gotten into you!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I've never seen you in this good a mood, and I was there when you had your very first piece of cake!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: It was your first birthday, and you were as naked as the day you were born.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's really weird that I never have clothes in these stories, Grandma.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Never mind that! Spill the beans, kid! What's got your goose a-gandering?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't tell you what happened exactly. But I can say that it was--

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: `--The best thing that's ever happened to you!` Monarch Prep is for the best and brightest. The Butterfly Detention Center is for those who've... Lost their shine.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]--The best thing that's ever happened to you![/i][/color] Monarch Prep is for the best and brightest. The Butterfly Detention Center is for those who've... Lost their shine.

nodes.text: Paige stands inside the Monarch Prep Detention Center in front of a heavy door with a single barred window.
She's in the middle of a long line of girls, all facing forward, standing shoulder to shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: But, with discipline and time, we can mold each of you back into an epitome of grace, beauty, and prestige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What happened to this place?! Where are all the fancy butlers?! The beautiful fountains?! The gold-plated... `Everything?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What happened to this place?! Where are all the fancy butlers?! The beautiful fountains?! The gold-plated... [color=#3b78e2][i]Everything?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Principal Whitford paces back and forth along the corridor. Her eyes lock on Paige for a second.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I see some familiar faces... So, let's get one thing straight!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: This is not the four-star hotel you might have been expecting!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You've been brought to me because you are `troubled.` And I have ways of dealing with trouble.
nodes.text_bbcode: You've been brought to me because you are [color=#3b78e2][i]troubled.[/i][/color] And I have ways of dealing with trouble.

nodes.text: A tall, muscular man emerges from the shadows and cracks his knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. Really subtle.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: A chatty volunteer! Brock, please show Paige how we deal with trouble nowadays.
Brock takes two hulking steps over to Paige and looms over her.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Five push-ups.
Brock extends an astonishingly muscular finger and points down at the ground.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Down. Five. Now.
She grabs the coat off the bed! A second later, Tad bursts into the room!
Paige hesitates!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I guess I'll grab the coat!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No time! Gotta grab something!
Paige scans the room quick, her eyes catching on two things: her favorite coat and a flower Owen gave her!
At the top of the stairs, Paige bursts into her room!
Paige spins, wrenching her shoulder free of Tad's vicegrip!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ow!
She bolts up the stairs, Tad right on her heels!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Get back here!
Paige spits on Tad's hand!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: `Yiiiiiick!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yiiiiiick![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He releases his grip on her shoulder, and she bolts up the stairs!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Get back down here!
Margot turns to Tad...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Why aren't you going after her?!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Because she just spit on me like some barbarian camel!
Paige tries to think of a way out, but she freezes!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know I should do `something!`
She points at a painting on the wall!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is that a painting of you, Tad?
Tad turns his head for one second...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: That? No, that's a donkey! Don't be--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You guys talked about disciplining me on your Valentine's Day getaway?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. Romance ever?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Young lady, as you know, Tad and I have decided that this recent behavior of yours needs to be corrected.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And we both agree that the best way to do that is to place you in Monarch Prep's Butterfly Detention Center!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I'm `really` looking forward to that!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] looking forward to that!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I think this recent outburst is grounds for accelerating when that happens...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And it should happen... It should happen...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Immediately.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?! When?!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: What part of `immediately` don't you understand?
nodes.text_bbcode: What part of [color=#e23b3b][i]immediately[/i][/color] don't you understand?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All of it! Sure, Owen doesn't bathe as much as he should, but that doesn't mean he's bad for me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If anything... He's the only `good` thing in my life.
nodes.text_bbcode: If anything... He's the only [color=#3b78e2][i]good[/i][/color] thing in my life.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Our decision is `final!` Go to your room, gather your essentials, and I'll have one of the servants bring around a towncar.
nodes.text_bbcode: Our decision is [color=#3b78e2][i]final![/i][/color] Go to your room, gather your essentials, and I'll have one of the servants bring around a towncar.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `No!` This is completely unfair!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color] This is completely unfair!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Have it your way then!
Margot snatches Paige's phone from her hands!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: We'll skip getting your stuff and leave at once!
Tad places a heavy hand on Paige's shoulder and marches her toward the front door.
She tries to wiggle free, but his hand clamps down even tighter!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Oh, we are `far` past sorry, Paige Eloise!
